desc: Precompute f(x) for all x from 1 to 20000000 using a sieve-like method.
Read the input N and the sequence A.
Create a frequency dictionary/array for the values in A.
Extract the distinct values and their counts from the frequency dictionary.
Iterate over all pairs of distinct values (u, v) with u <= v, compute f(u + v) and multiply by the appropriate count, and accumulate the total sum.
